turns.text: Yeah, I made a few of them on Wednesday. They're super easy to pull together and keep me fueled. It's nice not having to cook from scratch on a Saturday.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Absolutely, weekend meal-prepping pays off! Speaking of busy schedules, how have things been at the logistics firm lately? Has your account manager role been keeping you on your toes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It really has. We've had a lot of shipping transitions this month, so my days have been packed with client calls. I'm definitely appreciating this weekend break to just recharge.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet! Sounds like you've earned a restful weekend. Enjoy your lunch, your guitar practice, and that coffee shop trip later. Let me know if you need anything else today!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'll probably just take it easy and catch up with Sam later tonight. Talk to you soon!
